source.title: Hilton Cincinnati Airport conference fact sheet

notes: The ballroom rectangle is calibrated to the published 96 by 41 foot dimensions.
The source is schematic; outside-room dimensions are estimates and are not surveyed usable-space boundaries.
The blueprint includes public, private, and other meeting spaces as context. Only the ballroom is definite for this show.
A venue administrator must define approved optional space, entrances, exits, and obstacles.
